note: Every image the site stack runs, by digest (D-12, D-20). images: third-party, ref is <host>/<repository>:<tag>@sha256:<64 hex> (the multi-arch index digest; 47-03 re-pins if spike S1 records that only the linux/amd64 manifest digest survives the bundle copy), discovered by the compliance fit check. built: ours, built from deploy/images/<name>/image.json, digest null until published. release: published by another pipeline, digest null until published. The site registry serves each image at <site registry>/<sitePath>, see deploy/bundle/lib/locks.mjs.
